newsitem.title: USA: Universal Seismic names accounting chief.
newsitem.headline: Universal Seismic names accounting chief.

text.p: Universal Seismic Associates Inc said Monday that it hired Joe Rye as chief accounting officer.
Rye is a CPA and most recently has been active as a financial consultant and a director of companies in the energy and petrochemical fields.
Prior to this, Rye served as the chief financial officer and a director of Seagull Energy.

And Universal said that in connection with the settlement of a shareholder lawsuit, affiliates of Resource Investors Management Co, or "RIMCO", have entered into a $2 million loan agreement with the company with the proceeds being used to fund the settlement and expenses associated with the lawsuit.
